title: Revisiting Sustainability by Design in AI Protocol Governance: An Empirical Review of Comparative DAO and Corporate-Led Standards for the SDGs
abstract: arXiv:2606.05667v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: As artificial intelligence (AI) agents enter production infrastructure, interoperability protocols shape its governance and sustainability. This paper revisits our comparative study of two AI-agent interoperability standards, Ethereum Request for Comments 8004 (ERC-8004), governed by a decentralized autonomous organization (DAO), and Google's Agent2Agent (A2A), governed by a corporate consortium, through a Sustainability by Design (SbD) lens. Using an LLM-powered pipeline combining automated annotation, neural topic modeling, and multi-layer network analysis, we identify contrasting governance and innovation architectures. ERC-8004 relies on permissionless participation, rough consensus, and decoupled deployment, while A2A assigns binding authority to an eight-seat Technology Steering Committee. translated_title: 重新审视AI协议治理中的可持续性设计：面向可持续发展目标（SDGs）的DAO与企业主导标准比较的实证综述
translated_abstract: 随着人工智能（AI）智能体进入生产基础设施，互操作性协议正在塑造其治理与可持续性。本文通过“设计促可持续”（Sustainability by Design, SbD）的视角，重新审视我们对两种AI智能体互操作性标准的比较研究：一种是由去中心化自治组织（DAO）治理的以太坊征求意见稿8004（ERC-8004），另一种是由企业联盟治理的谷歌Agent2Agent（A2A）。我们采用结合自动标注、神经主题建模和多层网络分析的大语言模型驱动处理流程，识别出截然不同的治理与创新架构。ERC-8004依赖于无许可参与、粗略共识和解耦部署，而A2A则将约束性权力赋予一个由八个席位组成的技术指导委员会。DAO专注于信任与安全等构成性问题，包括构建什么以及为何构建，而联盟则分散……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文以“设计促可持续”视角，利用LLM驱动的自动标注、神经主题建模与多层网络分析流程，实证比较了DAO治理的ERC-8004与企业联盟治理的A2A两种AI智能体互操作性标准，揭示了二者截然不同的治理与创新架构。
en_tdlr: Through a Sustainability by Design lens and an LLM-powered pipeline combining automated annotation, neural topic modeling, and multi-layer network analysis, this paper empirically compares the DAO-governed ERC-8004 and the corporate-consortium-governed A2A AI-agent interoperability standards, revealing contrasting governance and innovation architectures.
